description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTerminationDao class, which provides database access methods related to employee termination records within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and listing termination reasons.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling employee termination records, extending the BaseDao class to include methods for saving, retrieving, and listing termination reasons.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeTerminationRecord entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeTerminationRecord by its ID; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns an array of all TerminationReason entities, ordered by name.
